Privacy & legal notice

Who we are and what we do with your details.

Who we are

Royal Family Eventing a.s.b.l., 29, rue Wilson, L-2732 Luxembourg, RCS F13431.
Email: royalfamilyeventing+web@gmail.com

Vendor and sponsor forms

When you send the form on "Sell at LCCC" or "Sponsors", we store what you entered (name, email, company or shop, phone if given, and your message) to contact you about selling at or sponsoring LCCC 2027. Legal basis: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time by email.

  • Your details are stored on our own server in the EU. Confirmation and notification emails are sent through Brevo (Sendinblue SAS, France).
  • We don't share them with anyone else and don't use them for advertising.
  • We delete them after the vendor selection and sponsor planning for LCCC 2027, or earlier if you ask.

Visiting this website

This website sets no cookies and uses no analytics. Our web server keeps short technical logs (IP address, date, page) to keep the site running and secure (legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

Your rights

You can ask us at any time what we store about you, and have it corrected or deleted. You can also complain to the Commission nationale pour la protection des données (CNPD), cnpd.lu.
